title: Mixing: Wings Over America by Wings | 1976
content:
Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tom Walsh

Wings continued mixing the live album Wings Over America on 13 November 1976.

On this day, the ninth of 13 mixing sessions, the song ‘My Love’ was worked on. It had been recorded on 21 May 1976 at the Nassau Coliseum in Uniondale.
